assumptions.assumption: The gap is the signed difference inholdpct - instownpct, so it is usually negative. Rows missing either value add nothing to a group's average gap.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-group average gaps. The NULL-event group counts as one group, and groups whose average gap is missing are skipped.

alternatives.interpretation: The gap is the absolute difference, ABS(inholdpct - instownpct), so it is never negative.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap FROM g) SELECT corpeventprx, avg_anlycount, avg_gap, avg_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg FROM o WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The gap is signed: insider ownership minus institutional ownership (inholdpct - instownpct), computed per snapshot. Rows missing either value are ignored in the gap average.

The 'overall average' is the unweighted mean of the per-event-type average gaps. This includes the no-event group and skips groups whose average gap is null. Rows are returned only if that mean is not null.
Snapshots with a NULL corpeventprx form their own group, which GROUP BY does natively and which is shown with a NULL event type.

alternatives.interpretation: The gap is the absolute difference between insider and institutional ownership, ABS(inholdpct - instownpct).
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_gap, g.avg_gap - o.overall_avg_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL

Snapshots with a NULL corpeventprx form one group, shown with a NULL event type.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-group average gaps. Groups whose average gap is missing are ignored. If that mean is NULL, no rows are returned.
